messages:
sam-sales: Quick sync — Zenith large-enterprise commit. They want 99.9% p50 latency 120ms for chat, 99th < 600ms, and guaranteed burst to 3x baseline for 10 min. Also asked for model fallback plan (smaller quantized variant) and a price uplift for reserved GPUs. Need answers by EOD.

morgan-se: Got it. Can you paste their traffic profile?

priya-ps: They sent CSV; baseline 200 rps, peak 600 rps sustained 10m, avg tokens/reply 180, 1.2 messages per session.

ethan-infra: Quick calc: tokens/s = 600 * 180 = 108000 tokens/s. On an A100 80GB with q4_0 model, sustained throughput ~20k tokens/s per GPU => need ~6 GPUs for steady peak; for 3x transient we'd need 18. Instead: reserve 8 GPUs and autoscale up to 16 + fallback quantized model to cover spikes.

morgan-se: Proposal: Reserved pool = 8 GPUs (monthly commit) + autoscale to 16 with burst credits. Fallback policy: route to 'redwood-mini-quant' when queue latency > 120ms or GPU pool utilization > 80%.

priya-ps: Pricing ask from finance: structure = base commit for 8 GPUs + burst usage billed at 1.8x unit price. Optional quantization setup fee one-time. Need to quantify per-GPU unit price.

jenna-legal: Security asks: they need SOC2 attestation, KMS/HSM integration details, and IAM audit logs retention. Also Q12 in questionnaire on key rotation — pls provide steps.

ethan-infra: Prewarm strategy: warm-standby lanes + lightweight prefix/KV cache to reduce cold-starts <50ms. Autoscale cooldown 120s, scale step +2 GPUs, conservative ramp-down to avoid oscillation.

sam-sales: Action items:
- Morgan: capacity note with the arithmetic + AZ-affinity scenarios
- Priya: draft pricing table with cross-AZ and per-AZ lines
- Ethan: prewarm/runbook and perf regression notes
- Jenna: legal answers for SOC2/KMS/Q12
I'll send to customer once docs are updated.

morgan-se: I'll put the calc + graph into internal note: https://redwood.internal/notes/zenith-capacity

priya-ps: Pricing table outline ready, will add fallback-model delta and optional setup fee.

ethan-infra: One blocker: customer requires strict AZ affinity (no cross-AZ pooling). That reduces efficiency ~25% — add ~2 GPUs per AZ or relax affinity.

sam-sales: @morgan-se call out AZ-affinity cost delta. @priya-ps include both pricing lines. If we can't meet 99th 600ms under AZ-affinity, propose SLO exception with credits.

jenna-legal: Also confirm pen-test window and monthly audit log export retention. We can offer 90-day retention as standard and 365-day as add-on.

ops-bot: scheduled prewarm window for zenith-test cluster tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

sam-sales: Thanks all :thumbsup:
